root-page.heading: Who We are?
root-page.description: Lions International District 325 K, under the designation Lions International Club, is a recognized and active branch of Lions Clubs International established in Nepal, dedicated to community service and humanitarian efforts. Through its structured network, Lions District 325 K serves as a powerful platform for individuals to contribute meaningfully to society and make a lasting impact in Nepal and beyond.

serve.title: We Serve
serve.discription: For over 100 years, Lions Clubs International has been empowering volunteers to serve their communities, meet humanitarian needs, encourage peace and promote international understanding.
serve.discription2: To empower Lions clubs, volunteers and partners to improve health and well-being, strengthen communities, and support those in need through humanitarian service and grants that impact lives globally, and encourage peace and international understanding.

clubCards.discription: Founded in 1917, we are the world's largest service club organization with 1.4 million members in over 48,000 clubs across 200+ countries and geographic areas. Our members are dedicated to creating positive change in communities worldwide.
clubCards.discription2: LCIF is the charitable arm of Lions Clubs International, funding humanitarian projects globally. Since 1968, LCIF has awarded over $1 billion in grants to support Lions' service efforts and disaster relief initiatives worldwide.

globalCauses.title: Our Global Causes
globalCauses.visionDiscription: Fighting preventable blindness and improving quality of life for people who are blind or visually impaired.
globalCauses.hungerDiscription: Ensuring access to nutritious food and clean water while addressing food insecurity in communities.
globalCauses.environmentDescription: Protecting and restoring our environment through sustainable community-based environmental projects.
globalCauses.diabetes: Reducing the prevalence of diabetes and improving quality of life for those diagnosed.

card.visionCareDis: Providing eye exams and treatments worldwide
card.envDes: Protecting our planet for future generations

peopleLooking.title: We're looking for people like you.

card1.title: Member experience
card1.discription: When you join Lions, you become part of a global network of volunteers working together to make a difference. You'll develop leadership skills, build lasting friendships, and create positive change in your community and beyond.

card2.title: Club and membership types
card2.discription: Lions clubs come in many forms - traditional, specialty, family, campus, and online clubs. Whether you have 30 minutes or 3 hours to volunteer, there's a way for you to make an impact through Lions.

card3.title: Where we serve
card3.discription: Lions serve in over 200 countries and geographic areas worldwide. From small rural communities to major metropolitan areas, Lions are working to address local needs while supporting global initiatives.

card4.title: How we serve
card4.discription: Through hands-on service, fundraising, and awareness campaigns, Lions tackle challenges in health, education, environment, and community development. We partner with organizations worldwide to maximize our impact.

lives.title: Lions change lives, including their own.

card1.title: Vision Projects
card1.text: Through Lions SightFirst program, we've helped restore sight to millions and prevented blindness in communities worldwide.

card2.title: Disaster Response
card2.text: When disasters strike, Lions are among the first to respond, providing immediate relief and long-term recovery support to affected communities.

card3.title: Youth Programs
card3.text: Our Leo clubs and youth programs empower the next generation of leaders to make a positive impact in their communities.

footers.info: Lions Clubs International is a renowned service organization founded by Melvin Jones in 1917. It has become one of the world’s leading and most active service club organizations.
